title: Arthur742Ramos/hadamard-668-lean
abstract: An independent Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of a supplied bordered block-circulant sign matrix of order 668.  The main theorem proves that there exists a 668 by 668 integer matrix with entries in {-1, 1}, diagonal row norm 668, and zero inner product between every pair of distinct rows. The formalization is a certificate-specific existence result, not a classification of Hadamard matrices and not a proof of the general Hadamard conjecture.
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
